facts_used: Datablocks are opaque to the initial Bikeshed parse until their closing tag.
Ordinary pre content does not activate shorthand autolinks; an l element is the explicit exception.
An a element without href is a manual autolink.
Definition attributes may be inherited from ancestors.
Heading elements h2 through h6 can be definition carriers.
Bibliographic links accept modifiers such as current, snapshot, inline, direct, index, and obsolete.

findings.title: The analyzer both admits invalid and omits valid bibliographic shorthands.
findings.impact: Candidate/disposition totality is false on a normative Bikeshed reference family, and the bounded suite is missing inputs that its own oracle already rejects.

findings.title: Mismatched closes leave stale same-name openings and can corrupt later state.
findings.impact: Tag ancestry, matching relations, processed-code ownership, candidate state, heading ownership, and definition scope can all be wrong after one malformed but nonthrowing sequence.

findings.title: The state machine does not implement Bikeshed pre/datablock/metadata activation semantics.
findings.impact: The denominator fabricates references and headings inside opaque source regions and ignores document-level shorthand configuration. rawState recognizes metadata and a narrow highlight spelling, not the Bikeshed datablock family.

findings.title: Whole normative reference and definition-carrier shapes remain absent.
findings.impact: A full-source occurrence ledger made from this analyzer would be incomplete even if every emitted row were correct. The implementation scans href-bearing a elements and dfn carriers only.

findings.title: Attribute provenance is byte-positioned but attribute values are not semantically parsed.
findings.impact: Resolved href identity can be wrong while both analyzer and oracle call it active and green. This is a direct common-mode failure of the platform-URL relation.

findings.title: The operation-ledger validator treats rejected status text as reviewed authority.
findings.impact: A syntactically nonempty status can admit an operation regardless of disposition, and collision reporting covers candidate hash collisions rather than the complete stable-ID namespace.

findings.title: The separate import closure is not an independent semantic oracle.
findings.impact: The oracle independently catches two analyzer defects, but it duplicates the source-state, attribute, URL, reference, carrier, and ledger policy closely enough to accept at least eight demonstrated semantic failures. Separate files are not sufficient independence.

findings.title: The verifier retains non-output-quadratic relations that the evidence rail neither counts nor exposes.
findings.impact: The analyzer improvements do not make the analyzer-plus-oracle qualification path scalable. No formal bound was claimed, but this subject cannot yet seed a trustworthy 168-source gate.

total_tranche.analysis: This analyzer cannot materialize the feature denominator that gates the direct parse-that apotheosis. It would both invent and omit source occurrences, then let a common-mode oracle certify many of those errors. No parser, grammar, feature, operation, owner, cost-lattice, movement, or production conclusion may be drawn from it.

wave.analysis: Repair generation 2 is reproducible and meaningfully better on its sealed cases, but it fails new bounded counterexamples in its own analyzer/oracle contract, violates Bikeshed source semantics, lacks complete occurrence families, and retains an unmeasured quadratic qualification path. The wave is not ready to seed the next denominator formation.

feature.analysis: Bibliographic references, tag recovery, pre/datablock states, manual autolinks, heading and inherited definition carriers, parsed hrefs, ledger review status, stable-ID namespace, and verifier resource behavior each have independently actionable defects.

required_repairs_before_rechallenge: Correct bibliographic target/modifier parsing and freeze both invalid-admission and valid-modifier cases.
Replace stale per-name opening removal with a relation that removes every implicitly closed row exactly once and prove processedDepth transactionality.
Derive Bikeshed pre, datablock, explicit l, opaque-element, and Markup Shorthands activation from a reviewed source-state contract rather than a narrow class regex.
Inventory manual a/l autolinks and all reviewed carrier families, including heading definitions and per-attribute nearest-ancestor inheritance.
Separate raw attribute byte provenance from decoded semantic attribute values before URL resolution.
Give review_status an explicit authority enum and reject nonaccepted rows before operation emission; collision-check the union stable-ID namespace in the analyzer output.
Rebuild the oracle from an independently specified semantic model or an authenticated Bikeshed witness, and add every common-mode case above as an externally judged vector.
Index oracle state and preceding-heading lookups, count verifier work, and expose geometric timing values rather than booleans before any full-source run.
